# wpur

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/N-Yukihiro/wpur/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/N-Yukihiro/wpur/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![Codecov test coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/N-Yukihiro/wpur/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/N-Yukihiro/wpur)
<!-- badges: end -->

`wpur` implements the unified alpha-divergence framework proposed by Wada and Kamahara (2024) for measuring whole picture of unequal representation.

## Installation

You can install the development version of wpur from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` {r install, eval = FALSE}
# install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load_gh("N-Yukihiro/wpur")
```

## Example

```{r setup}
library(wpur)
```

```{r example}
election <- tibble::tribble(
  ~district, ~party, ~votes, ~elected,
  "D1", "Party A", 60, 1,
  "D1", "Party B", 40, 1,
  "D2", "Party A", 40, 1,
  "D2", "Party B", 60, 1
)

decompose_unequal_representation(
  data = election,
  party_var = party,
  district_var = district,
  votes_var = votes,
  elected_var = elected,
  alpha = 2,
  election_info = TRUE
)
```
